title: Annotatio VI §.III: Scripture for the Antitheses’ antitheses — James, Paul, Psalms, John 6, Rom. 1/9, 1 Pet.
pass_a_gloss: e.g. That solitary Faith does not justify — James 2 entire. That Good Works are necessary to Salvation — 1 Cor. 7:19; Gal. 5:6; Heb. 12:14. That Faith in Christ and the Holy Spirit are not wholly lost by any act of sinning however partly voluntary — Ps. 51:13; 2 Sam. 7:14. That Christ’s Body is not taken corporeally together with the Bread and by the Mouth of the Body, but Spiritually and by the Mouth of faith, and thence is not to be sought in the Bread but asked from Heaven; nor received by unbelievers but by the faithful only — John 6:35 and vv. 47–59, also v. 63 compared among themselves. That Omnipotence does not belong to Christ according to the Humanity — John 10: The Father is greater than I (considered as man); Therefore also in respect of Power: but that to Christ according to the human Nature all finite things belong, and infinite things conversely according to the Divine Nature — Rom. 1:3–4; ch. 9:5; 1 Pet. 3:18; 4:1.
pass_b_english: For example: solitary faith does not justify (James 2 entire); good works are necessary to salvation (1 Cor. 7:19; Gal. 5:6; Heb. 12:14).
Faith in Christ and the Spirit are not wholly lost by every partly voluntary act of sin (Ps. 51:13; 2 Sam. 7:14).
Christ’s body is taken spiritually by the mouth of faith, not corporeally with the bread by the body’s mouth — sought from heaven, received by the faithful only (John 6:35, 47–59, 63).
Omnipotence does not belong to Christ according to the humanity (John 10; Rom. 1:3–4; 9:5; 1 Pet. 3:18; 4:1).
